plugins.name: mindful-claude
plugins.description: Guided breathing exercises above the Claude Code prompt while Claude works; the spinner reads the breath

plugins.name: image-peek
plugins.description: Preview pasted images at their prompt markers on macOS. Ghostty, plus experimental iTerm2 and Herdr support with a startup override. Reach L2: local clipboard capture and temporary files, no model or network calls.

plugins.name: mod-builder
plugins.description: A skill that plans, writes, validates, proves, reviews, migrates and publishes Claude Code mods. Plan first with the smallest $ surface, a footprint diffed against the plan, a test seen failing, an isolated load that leaves evidence files, a five-line threat model, and a handoff that names what was and was not proven. Brainstorm mode checks ideas against every mod already on GitHub.

via: 'npx -y -p typescript tsc (no tsc on PATH; the first typecheck downloads TypeScr

plugins.name: fable-pin
plugins.description: Pins every subagent to the fable model by rewriting agent.spawn, with /fable-pin on, off and status. Reach L0: its own store and one command, nothing else.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: cache-tax, the Mod. Stops a cold send once with its price, keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm for a window you set (/keepwarm 6h), arms that for you after a paid cold write, and keeps score. Reach L2, one $.model.fork per idle stretch, its own store, a status slot; sees prompt length only.

plugins.name: lcm
plugins.description: Lossless context management — DAG-based summarization that preserves every message

plugins.name: cc-arcade
plugins.description: Games above the Claude Code prompt (snake, Tetris, Doom, 2048, Minesweeper, Flappy, Pong, typing test, Space Invaders) that pause when Claude finishes a turn, and a pet that grows as Claude tests, commits and edits. Clones of the genre, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tetris Holding, Taito, Atari or id Software

plugins.name: prompt-rail
plugins.description: A rail of your session's prompts beside the transcript or above the prompt; hover to read one, click to jump to it.

plugins.name: agent-flow
plugins.description: /flow opens a live, read-only tree of the session's subagents and teammates beside the transcript: status, current tool call, waits for approval, elapsed time, tokens; prints the same tree as text where no pane can be drawn

plugins.name: pixelband
plugins.description: Animated pixel-art scenes or your own image above the prompt, reacting to Claude. Zero tokens.

plugins.name: context-lens
plugins.description: Live /context: what fills the window, per-turn growth, and distance to auto-compaction.

plugins.name: quota-meter
plugins.description: 5-hour and weekly plan limits with reset countdown and projected time until you hit them.

plugins.name: token-ledger
plugins.description: Per-turn cost, tokens and cache hit ratio, with the session total.

plugins.name: budget-guard
plugins.description: Stops a session before it runs past a budget: warns near a cost or plan-window limit, then refuses tool calls and asks before the next prompt.

plugins.name: agent-narrator
plugins.description: Watch the agent work: every step in plain English, with a live time-saved counter

plugins.name: agent-race
plugins.description: Race Claude Code sessions on a task: live split-screen race track scoreboard

plugins.name: boss-fight
plugins.description: Failing tests spawn a pixel boss; every run that fixes tests lands a hit, zero failures is a KO with loot

plugins.name: burn-meter
plugins.description: Live session cost odometer above the prompt: a burning fuse, real-world comparisons, threshold alerts

plugins.name: code-pet
plugins.description: A pixel pet that lives in a pane and reacts to what Claude does: eats on tool calls, gets sick on failures, panics on rm -rf, sleeps when idle, evolves as you ship

plugins.name: inbox-alerts
plugins.description: Gmail + Slack alerts inside Claude Code: toasts, status count, and an Alerts pane

plugins.name: inner-monologue
plugins.description: A pane of Claude's dry inner thoughts about your session, typed out live

plugins.name: launch-codes
plugins.description: Dangerous Bash commands need launch codes: red alert pane, siren, a code to arm and a LAUNCH to fire

plugins.name: session-wrapped
plugins.description: Spotify Wrapped for a Claude Code session: an animated stat reveal and a shareable PNG card

plugins.name: sportscaster
plugins.description: Live TV play-by-play of your Claude Code session, spoken aloud with crowd effects

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: Mission control for subagents and agent teams: who is running, what each is doing, who spawned whom, who is talking to whom

plugins.name: review-pane
plugins.description: claude review: the session's latest reply in a calm reading pane docked beside the conversation

plugins.name: review-pane
plugins.description: Side pane showing the files changed in this conversation as diffs; mark lines, comment, and send the comments back to Claude

plugins.name: buffer-pane
plugins.description: A pane beside the transcript that holds the next things to tell the agent: write blocks of text while a turn runs, then press [+] to put one block into the prompt box.

plugins.name: pull-request-pane
plugins.description: A pane beside the transcript with the GitHub pull requests and issues related to the current session: drag a title or description to leave a comment on it, add as many as you like, then Submit sends them all as one prompt. Watch each pull request's checks, review decision and mergeability update on a timer.

plugins.name: md-prompt
plugins.description: Paints Markdown onto the prompt box as you type: syntax-highlighted code blocks, inline code, bold, italic, lists, tables, quotes, links and headings. Paint only, your text is never changed.

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: Read-only side chat: /aside opens a pane where you ask about the session so far, answered by a tool-less fork of the transcript; nothing is written back into the main thread.

plugins.name: prismantis
plugins.description: Colorful, themeable rendering for Claude Code replies: tables, headings, code, numbers, paths and links.

plugins.name: cctop
plugins.description: btop-style live dashboard for Claude Code internals: /cctop opens it in a side pane, cctop-insights lets the session answer questions from its numbers

plugins.name: secret-redactor
plugins.description: Keeps secrets, email addresses and IP addresses out of the session transcript, and puts the real value back on the way into a tool call

plugins.name: vercel-deploy-status
plugins.description: Pins the Vercel deploy queue of the linked project under the prompt: every deploy queued, building or just finished, with its phase and elapsed time

plugins.name: topic-filter
plugins.description: Keep unrelated topics from pulling Claude off your code: listed terms become stable placeholder names (or their lines are dropped) before the model reads them.

plugins.name: roll-credits
plugins.description: Movie-style credits for your Claude Code session

plugins.name: claude-mermaid
plugins.description: Mermaid diagrams drawn as box art inline in the transcript.

plugins.name: claude-queue
plugins.description: /q <text> while Claude is working waits in a stack above the prompt and goes out when the turn ends.

plugins.name: deploy-verify
plugins.description: Verifies the live URL after a deploy command succeeds.

plugins.name: mini-offload
plugins.description: Routes heavy Bash commands to a second machine over ssh, syncing the commit first.

plugins.name: scope-guard
plugins.description: Stops a turn that has edited too many files until the goal is restated.

plugins.name: merge-gate
plugins.description: Denies a merge unless the latest human message says merge; ship, push and deploy do not count.

plugins.name: receipt
plugins.description: A receipt in the turn footer: edits, runs and curls, a warning when edits ran nothing, unfolded destructive commands, and a spinner that names an unverified claim.

plugins.name: diff-review
plugins.description: A docked pane with each edited file's hunk and keep or revert buttons that act without a model turn.

plugins.name: money-band
plugins.description: A money line above the prompt, read from SQLite databases over ssh.

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Limit windows, context fill and cost above the prompt, with a nudge to clear.

plugins.name: copy-band
plugins.description: Click-to-copy buttons above the prompt for the last answer's blocks, plus a durable stash.

plugins.name: chrome-switch
plugins.description: Switches the Chrome profile Claude drives with no approval click.

plugins.name: wod-band
plugins.description: A pixel Ragtag athlete above the prompt: every turn is a rep, the session is an AMRAP.

plugins.name: wod-timer
plugins.description: 3, 2, 1, GO on submit, a running clock per turn, and the split when it lands.

plugins.name: done-blink
plugins.description: Blinks the iTerm2 tab orange when a turn lands, until you type again or three minutes pass.

plugins.name: clawdhouse
plugins.description: A pixel Clawd in a side pane that reacts to what Claude is doing

plugins.name: cost-git
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: session and last-message cost, plus git branch, status, CI, pull and push

plugins.name: session-monitor
plugins.description: A side panel with live cards for every open Claude Code session. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: usage-ticker
plugins.description: A usage board for Claude Code: a weekly pace gauge and a sliding ticker of your spend per model, in the terminal and on the desktop.

plugins.name: familiar
plugins.description: A pixel-art companion above the prompt that reacts to your session, levels up, and can be redrawn by hand

plugins.name: compound-engineering
plugins.description: Brainstorm, plan, debug, review, and compound learnings with AI agents

plugins.name: claude-mem
plugins.description: Persistent memory system for Claude Code - context compression across sessions
